blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge. Existing research increasingly relies on architecturally complex multi-branch pipelines or computationally intensive fine-tuning of single-branch backbones. In this paper, we investigate whether a single frozen video foundation model can serve as an effective NR-VQA backbone, and propose HiVE-VQA, the first framework (to our knowledge) to apply a JEPA-based video encoder to this task. HiVE-VQA extracts token grids from multiple depths of a pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder and stacks them into a hierarchical spatio-temporal volume, which a compact 3D convolutional head fuses across its layer, spatial, and temporal axes, combining low-level distortion cues from shallow layers with the semantic and temporal context captured at greater depths. The encoder remains frozen throughout, so only the head is trained: 5.2M parameters (5.7\% of the total), with no auxiliary multi-modal models and an inference cost that is invariant to video resolution. Trained solely on LSVQ and evaluated without any fine-tuning, HiVE-VQA outperforms 17 state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in SROCC and PLCC on both intra-dataset (LSVQ-test, LSVQ-1080p) and cross-dataset (KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC) benchmarks. These results indicate that hierarchical, depth-wise fusion of features from a single frozen video foundation model provides a more effective and efficient basis for NR-VQA than task-specific multi-network fusion. Code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA.
blocks.zh: 用户生成的视频内容激增,使得准确而有力的无参考视频质量评估(NR-VQA)成为一项非常重要的挑战. 现有的研究越来越依赖于建筑复杂的多分支管线或计算密集的单分支骨干微调. 在本文中,我们调查单一的冷冻视频基础模型是否能够作为有效的NR-VQA主干,并提议Hive-VQA,这是(据我们所知)将基于JEPA的视频编码器应用到这项任务的第一个框架. HiVE-VQA从预先训练的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的多深度中提取代号网格,并将其堆积成一个层次分明的螺旋-时空体积,一个紧凑的3D演化头部在它的地层,空间,和时间轴上引信,将浅层的低水平扭曲提示与在更深处捕获的语义和时间背景相结合. 编码器在整个过程中保持冷冻,所以只有头部被训练:5.2M参数(占总数的5.7×××),没有辅助的多模式模型,推论成本对视频解析度来说是变化无常的. 仅就LSVQ进行训练,未经任何微调评价,Hive-VQA在SROCC和PLCC在内部数据集(LSVQ测试,LSVQ-1080p)和跨数据集(KoNViD-1k,LIVE-VQC)基准上都超过了17个最先进的(SOTA)方法. 这些结果表明,从一个单一的冷冻视频基础模型中分层、深度地对特性进行整合,为NR-VQA提供了比针对特定任务的多网络整合更有效和更高效的基础。 在https://github.com/RobHam99/HiVE-VQA上可查询代码和示范检查站。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: With the emergence of social networking sites in the previous decades, there has been a significant increase in the amount of video content produced and consumed across the world every single day. According to the CISCO annual report [ 4 ] , 82 % 82\% of global internet traffic is video content, and the number of mobile devices grew from 8 billion in 2018, to 13 billion in 2023. This rapid adoption of portable handheld devices, combined with the increase in user-generated content (UGC) produced on social networking sites, creates a huge demand for automated systems that are capable of monitoring and evaluating the quality of content produced and uploaded to these sites. While humans are excellent at evaluating video quality, these subjective evaluations are time consuming and costly. It is of vital importance to develop objective video quality assessment (VQA) metrics that are capable of rapidly and accurately assessing the quality of this user-generated content.
blocks.zh: 随着过去几十年社交网站的出现,全世界每天制作和消费的视频内容数量都大幅增加. 根据CISCO年度报告[4],全球82%的82%的互联网流量是视频内容,移动设备的数量从2018年的80亿增长到2023年的130亿. 这种快速采用便携式手持设备,加上社交网站所制作的用户生成内容(UGC)的增加,对能够监测和评价制作并上传到这些网站的内容质量的自动化系统产生了巨大的需求. 虽然人类在评价视频质量方面表现优异,但这些主观评价既费时又费钱. 至关重要的是,要制定客观的视频质量评估(VQA)衡量标准,以便能够迅速准确地评估用户生成的内容的质量。

blocks.en: Video quality assessment metrics are typically divided into two sub-categories: conventional and deep-learning metrics. Conventional VQA metrics [ 27 , 38 , 13 , 37 , 33 , 28 , 6 , 29 , 20 ] exploit the statistical properties of video scenes to handcraft features that correlate with perceptual quality. These features can be modeled directly, or using machine learning-based models such as random forests. Due to the rigidity of these techniques, they often fail to capture the information required to model complex combinations of distortions and content types. Consequently, these models may generalize poorly to real-world UGC, which exhibits a diverse range of content and distortion characteristics.
blocks.zh: 视频质量评估度量衡通常分为两个子类:常规和深层学习度量衡. 常规VQA衡量标准[27、38、13、37、33、28、6、29、20] 利用视频场景的统计特性来制作与视觉质量相关的手工艺品。 这些特征可以被直接建模,或者使用机器学习模型如随机森林. 由于这些技术的刚性,它们往往无法捕捉到所需的信息来模拟扭曲和内容类型的复杂组合. 因此,这些模型可能不适当地概括到现实世界的UGC,它显示出各种内容和扭曲特征。

blocks.en: The advance of deep learning architectures over the past decade has stimulated substantial interest in their application to VQA. Deep VQA metrics [ 50 , 15 , 42 , 47 , 48 , 26 , 43 , 16 , 3 , 45 , 46 , 25 , 8 , 7 , 24 , 23 , 49 , 52 ] have demonstrated a strong capability in extracting high-dimensional features that capture diverse distortions with different content types. These models have achieved excellent performance in full-reference (FR) tasks - where the features of a distorted video can be directly compared with those of its pristine reference. However, UGC typically lacks such pristine counterparts, since their degradations may originate during capture due to limitations in recording devices, acquisition conditions, or film practices [ 19 ] . Consequently, no-reference (NR) quality assessment for UGC poses a more challenging problem, requiring models to infer perceptual quality solely from the degraded video itself.
blocks.zh: 过去十年来深入学习架构的进步激发了人们对将其应用到VQA的极大兴趣. 深 VQA 度量衡 [50, 15, 42, 47, 48, 26, 43, 16, 3, 45, 46, 25, 8, 7, 24, 23, 49, 52] 显示具有很强的能力,可以提取出高维度特征,捕捉不同内容类型的不同扭曲. 这些模型在全面参考(FR)任务中取得了出色的性能——可以直接将被歪曲的视频的特征与其原始参考的特征进行比较. 然而,UGC通常缺乏这种原始的对应物,因为它们的降解可能源于捕获过程中由于记录设备、获取条件或电影做法的限制[19].。 因此,UGC的不参考质量评估提出了更具挑战性的问题,要求模型仅从已退化的视频本身推断出感知质量。

blocks.en: Of relevance to this challenge, a new self-supervised deep-learning framework, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) [ 2 ] , has been designed to learn semantically rich and context-aware image representations for downstream tasks. Recent works have extended the JEPA paradigm to video [ 1 ] and further enhanced local spatio-temporal representations through dense predictive objectives [ 30 ] , making JEPA-based models promising backbone candidates for low-level vision tasks.
blocks.zh: 与这一挑战相关的是,一个新的自我监督的深入学习框架 -- -- " 联合规划建筑 " [2] -- -- 旨在为下游任务学习内容丰富和了解背景的形象表现。 近期的作品将JEPA范式扩展到了视频[1],并通过密集的预测目标来进一步提升了当地的时空表现[30],使基于JEPA的模型为低水平的愿景任务提供有希望的骨干候选人.

blocks.en: In this context, we investigate whether a frozen, self-supervised video foundation model can serve as an effective backbone for NR-VQA without task-specific encoder fine-tuning or multi-network ensembles. The paper proposes HiVE-VQA, which first extracts tokens from multiple depths of a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder in order to capture dense multi-scale features. HiVE-VQA then restructures the tokens into a hierarchical volume - combining depth, spatial, and temporal dimensions. This restructuring process allows us to apply lightweight 3D convolutions across the volume, mapping our spatio-temporal and multi-scale features into a single quality score. The main contributions of our work are:
blocks.zh: 在这方面,我们调查一个被冷冻的,自我监督的视频基础模型是否能够作为NR-VQA的有效骨干,而不进行任务特定的编码器微调或多网络综艺. 论文提出了HiVE-VQA,它首先从被冻结的V-JEPA 2.1编码器的多深度取出符号,以捕捉密集多尺度特征. 然后,HIVE-VQA将符号重组为分级的量 -- -- 结合了深度、空间和时间维度。 这个重组过程使我们能够在整个音量上应用轻量级的3D演化,将我们的时空和多尺度特征映射成一个单一的质量分数. 我们工作的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • JEPA backbone for NR-VQA. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of a JEPA-based video encoder to NR-VQA. We show that a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 backbone provides a substantially stronger fixed representation than a comparably sized image-pretrained ViT (+0.080 average SROCC, Table 6 ), requiring no encoder fine-tuning and only 5.2M trainable parameters. • A volumetric quality head. We propose a compact 3D convolutional head that takes restructured token grids at multiple depths of the vision transformer and then fuses them across the depth, spatial, and temporal axes. It outperforms a baseline regressor by +0.040 average SROCC (Table 6 ), while hierarchical multi-layer fusion provides a further improvement over final-layer features at negligible additional cost (Table 5 ). • State-of-the-art accuracy. HiVE-VQA achieves the best performance across four UGC benchmarks (Figure 1 ) among 17 existing SOTA NR-VQA methods, supporting resolution-invariant inference.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频质量评估

blocks.en: The lack of a pristine reference sequence makes no-reference assessment inherently more challenging than full-reference tasks, as models cannot directly exploit the statistical or representational differences between distorted and reference content. No-Reference VQA methods are typically divided into two categories: classical and deep learning-based.
blocks.zh: 缺乏纯正的参考序列使得无参考评估本质上比全面参考任务更具挑战性,因为模型无法直接利用被扭曲和参考内容之间的统计或代表差异. no-Reference VQA方法一般分为两类:古典法和深层学习法.

blocks.en: Classical NR-VQA methods. Many conventional image quality metrics are based on measuring the similarity of handcrafted frame-level features to the distributions of natural scene statistics. These frame-level features are then pooled along the temporal dimension and mapped to a quality score using a regression technique, most commonly the support vector regressor [ 27 , 29 , 20 ] . To exploit the additional temporal information present in videos, video-specific metrics were subsequently developed. Models like VIIDEO [ 28 ] leverage frame differentials, while BLIINDS [ 33 ] utilizes natural scene statistics with additional temporal modeling. ChipQA [ 6 ] is motivated by the concept of space-time slices, measuring naturalness at the video level. Some other conventional metrics reduce complexity by selecting key frames of a video to compute multi-level features on [ 13 , 37 ] . While these models employ sophisticated modeling techniques, the diversity of UGC content requires models capable of extracting more dynamic features.
blocks.zh: 经典NR-VQA方法. 许多传统的图像质量度量法是基于测量手动帧层特征与自然场景统计分布的相似性. 这些帧级特征然后按照时间维度集合,并使用回归技术被映射为质量分数,最常见的是支持向量回流器[27,29,20]. 为了利用视频中的其他时间信息,随后制定了针对视频的衡量标准。 VIIDEO等模型 [28] 杠杆帧差,而BLINDS [33] 利用自然场景统计,并附加了时间模型. ChipQA [6] 以时空切片的概念为动力,在视频层面测量自然性. 其他一些常规度量衡则通过选择视频的关键帧来计算[13,37]上的多层特性来降低复杂性. 虽然这些模型采用了尖端的建模技术,但UGC内容的多样性需要能够提取出更能活泼特征的模型.

blocks.en:
Deep learning-based NR-VQA methods. The massive increase in visual data over the past decade, coupled with advances in deep learning, has stimulated the development of deep VQA models. While such metrics are computationally demanding, they typically produce features that are more expressive and sensitive to a wide range of distortions and content types. CNN-based VQA models were among the earliest deep architectures investigated for NR-VQA [ 38 , 50 , 3 , 15 ] . Some have been trained using semi-supervised training paradigms [ 23 , 24 ] , allowing the models to learn from a greater volume of data without requiring human-annotated quality labels.
The advent of the transformer architecture [ 39 , 5 ] has yielded NR-VQA methods with increasingly strong performance. Semi-supervised training schemes have also been used with transformer models [ 8 , 7 ] . To counter the computational demands of transformer models, FAST-VQA [ 45 , 46 ] introduced a fragment sampling strategy, allowing computational costs to remain approximately invariant to the source video resolution.
Many modern NR-VQA metrics trade efficiency for improved performance by integrating multiple specialist networks that capture complementary views, scales, or aspects of video quality [ 42 , 47 , 43 , 52 , 26 ] . While transformers and CNNs are still the dominant architectures in modern NR-VQA, other techniques such as language-based models [ 49 , 48 ] , and state-space models [ 25 ] are also demonstrating excellent performance on UGC quality assessment tasks.
blocks.zh:
深入学习NR-VQA方法. 过去十年来视觉数据大量增加,加上深入学习的进展,刺激了深度VQA模型的发展. 虽然这种衡量标准在计算上要求很高,但它们通常会产生更能表达和敏感地反映各种扭曲和内容类型的特征。 基于CNN的VQA模型是NR-VQA调查最早的深层建筑[38,50,3,15]. 其中一些培训采用半监督培训范式[23,24],使模型能够从更大数量的数据中学习,而不需要人力附加质量标签。
变压器架构的出现[39,5]产生了性能越来越强的NR-VQA方法. 半监督的培训计划也被用于变压器型号[8,7]. 为了应对变压器模型的计算需要,FAST-VQA [45,46] 引入了碎片取样策略,使得计算成本仍然对源视频解析度有大约的不相干.
许多现代NR-VQA的计量标准通过整合多个专家网络,获取互补观点、尺度或视频质量的方面[42、47、43、52、26],提高绩效的贸易效率。 虽然变压器和有线电视新闻网仍然是现代NR-VQA的主导架构,但基于语言的模型[49,48]等其它技术,以及状态-空间模型[25]也在UGC质量评估任务上展现出出色的表现.

blocks.en: UGC Datasets. We evaluate the proposed HiVE-VQA variants on four widely used UGC subjective quality datasets, including LSVQ 1080p \text{LSVQ}_{\text{1080p}} and LSVQ test \text{LSVQ}_{\text{test}} [ 50 ] , KoNViD-1k [ 11 , 10 ] , LIVE-VQC [ 34 ] , and YouTube-UGC [ 41 ] . HiVE-VQA is pre-trained on LSVQ train \text{LSVQ}_{\text{train}} , which is a subset of the main LSVQ dataset comprising 28,056 video clips. After pre-training, intra-dataset evaluation is performed on the two LSVQ test datasets, which contain 7,400 and 3,600 videos, respectively. To evaluate our model’s generalization ability on UGC with distributions different from that of the training data, we perform cross-dataset evaluation on KoNViD-1k (1,200 sequences) and LIVE-VQC (585 sequences). To further assess the model’s adaptability to specific data, we also fine-tuned HiVE-VQA on KoNViD-1k, LIVE-VQC, and the public YouTube-UGC dataset (1,380 sequences).

blocks.en: Evaluation Criteria. The correlation between the predicted quality indices and subjective quality scores is measured based on two correlation statistical metrics: Spearman Rank Order Correlation Coefficient (SROCC) [ 35 ] and Pearson Linear Correlation Coefficient (PLCC) [ 31 ] . The SROCC measures the monotonic relationship between the model’s predictions and human-annotated mean-opinion scores (MOS), thereby reflecting the ranking capability of the model. PLCC is used to evaluate the model’s prediction accuracy by calculating the linear correlation between the model’s predicted scores and the MOS scores after non-linear fitting [ 40 ] . For both metrics, a higher score indicates better performance.
blocks.zh: 评价标准。 预测质量指数与主观质量分数之间的关联性是根据两个相关统计度量衡量的: Spearman Rank Order 相干系数 (SROCC) [35]和相干系数 (PLCC) [31]. SROCC测量模型的预测与人类附加说明的平均值分数(MOS)之间的单调关系,从而反映模型的排名能力. PLCC用于通过计算模型的预测分数与MOS分数在非线性相接后[40]的线性关联来评价模型的预测精度. 对于这两个衡量标准,较高的分数表明表现较好。

blocks.en: 4.2 Pre-training results on LSVQ
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 关于LSVQ的培训前结果

blocks.en: We pre-train our model on LSVQ train and conduct inference on the two intra-dataset test sets (LSVQ test and LSVQ 1080p ). We conduct additional cross-dataset inference on KoNViD-1k and LIVE-VQC in order to assess the generalizability of our model to UGC. Our results are compared in Table 1 with 17 SOTA classical and deep model benchmarks. Across all four test datasets, our model outperforms all of the classical VQA metrics included in the benchmark. Compared with all single-branch models in the literature, it achieves superior performance, improving mean SROCC and PLCC by 1.74% and 1.60%, respectively. Although our model adopts a single-branch architecture, it still outperforms all multi-branch models, with improvements of 2.57% and 2.30% in SROCC and PLCC, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们先在LSVQ列车上预训我们的模型,然后对两套内数据集测试集(LSVQ测试和LSVQ 1080p.)进行推论. 我们对KONViD-1k和LIVE-VQC进行更多的跨数据集推论,以评估我们的模型对UGC的可通用性. 我们的结果在表1中与17个SOTA古典和深层模型基准作了比较。 在所有四个测试数据集中,我们的模型的性能都超过了基准中包含的所有经典的VQA指标. 与文献中所有单分支模型相比,它取得了优异的性能,平均SROCC和PLCC分别提高了1.74%和1.60%. 虽然我们的模型采用了单分支架构,但它仍然超越了所有多分支模式,在SROCC和PLCC的改进率分别为2.57%和2.30%.

blocks.en: 4.3 Fine-tuning results on UGC datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). UGC 数据集的微调结果

blocks.en: To verify the effectiveness of our model on downstream tasks, we fine-tune HiVE-VQA on three of the previously mentioned datasets (LIVE-VQC, KoNViD-1k and YouTube-UGC). We repeat the fine-tuning process 10 times across a 70/10/20% dataset split (train/val/test), and report the median performance across the 10 runs in Table 2 . It is noted that HiVE-VQA once again achieves the best average performance among all models, improving SROCC and PLCC by 0.11% and 1.10%, respectively, over the best multi-branch model. HiVE-VQA also demonstrates competitive fine-tuning performance compared with other state-of-the-art single-branch models. While our model obtains evident performance gains ( + 3.64 % +3.64\% in SROCC and + 3.46 % +3.46\% in PLCC) on LIVE-VQC, it does not consistently outperform all single-branch models when fine-tuned on multiple datasets, and is only the fourth best model on YouTube-UGC [ 41 ] . This is likely because we keep our encoder frozen, while other networks are able to tune their features to better represent the dataset distribution; the gap widens for HiVE-VQA-M, most visibly on high-resolution YouTube-UGC.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的模型在下游任务上的有效性,我们对前面提到的三套数据集(LIVE-VQC,KoNViD-1k和YouTube-UGC)进行了微调. 我们在70/10/20%的数据集拆分(列车/值/测试)中重复了10次微调过程,并在表2中报告10个数据集的中位业绩。 需要指出的是,HIVE-VQA再次在所有模型中实现了最佳平均性能,比最佳多分支模型分别提高了0.11%和1.10%。 HIVE-VQA还展示了与其他最先进的单分支模型相比的竞争性微调性能. 虽然我们的模型在LIVE-VQC上获得了明显的性能收益(SROCC中+3.64%+3.64+++3.46++3.46++++),但当在多个数据集上进行微调时,它并没有一贯地超越所有单一分支模型,而只是YouTube-UGC上第四好模型[41]. 这可能是因为我们保持了编码器的冻结,而其他网络则能够调谐它们的特性来更好地代表数据集的分布;对于Hive-VQA-M来说,差距会扩大,在高分辨率的YouTube-UGC上最为明显.

blocks.en: 4.4 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 效率

blocks.en: We evaluate the efficiency of HiVE-VQA by comparing both variants with other SOTA NR-VQA models. At 1080p HiVE-VQA is roughly 11 × 11\times , 15 × 15\times , and 29 × 29\times less computationally expensive than VSFA, PVQ, and BVQA respectively, while processing each video in under a quarter of a second. Compared with more recent fragment-based and efficient models, HiVE-VQA can be considered in the same lightweight regime. Although FasterVQA, FAST-VQA, and DOVER report lower FLOPs, they employ considerably smaller backbones; HiVE-VQA instead retains a full transformer encoder with superior SROCC and PLCC, and only 5.2M trainable parameters. Our smaller variant, HiVE-VQA-M, is on the same order of FLOPs as the most lightweight model, FasterVQA, while yielding average SROCC and PLCC gains of +0.026 and +0.025 respectively. This analysis indicates HiVE-VQA is a promising alternative for realistic implementations of UGC NR-VQA. We acknowledge the larger size of the total parameter count, which future work will aim to condense through techniques such as knowledge distillation [ 9 ] and model pruning [ 53 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较两种变体与其他SOTA NR-VQA模型来评价Hive-VQA的效率. 在1080p HiVE-VQA的计算成本上分别大约为11×11分,15×15分,29×29分分别比VSFA,PVQ和BVQA低,同时每段视频的处理时间不到四分之一秒. 与更近期的以碎片为基础的高效模型相比,Hive-VQA可以被考虑在同一轻量级系统中. 虽然更快速的VQA,FAST-VQA,和DOVER报告较低的FLOP,但是它们使用的是更小得多的骨干;而Hive-VQA则保留了具有上等SROCC和PLCC的全变压器编码器,只有5.2M可列车参数. 我们的更小的变体"HiVE-VQA-M"在FLOP的顺序上与最轻的型号"快活VQA"相同,同时平均SROCC和PLCC的增益分别为+0.026和+0.025. 这一分析表明,HIVE-VQA是现实执行UGC NR-VQA的有希望的替代办法. 我们承认总参数计数的大小较大,未来工作将力求通过知识分馏[9]和模型推算[53,14]等技术来收缩.

blocks.en: 4.5 Encoder Representation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.5 编码器代表分析

blocks.en: Analysis of Embedding Sensitivity. We visualize the representational capacity of our framework in Figure 3 . We take a video sequence, apply four different synthetic degradations, extract features from the encoder, and compute the first three principal components for each patch. These components are then mapped to RGB channels and plotted as an image. The resulting visualizations show that each type of distortion produces features with distinct representations, indicating that the V-JEPA 2.1 is indeed sensitive to various distortions.
blocks.zh: 嵌入灵敏度分析. 我们在图3中描绘了我们框架的代表能力。 我们用一个视频序列,应用四个不同的合成降解,从编码器中提取特性,并计算出每个补丁的前三个主要组件. 这些组件然后被映射到RGB通道并被映射成图像. 由此产生的可视化显示,每一种扭曲都产生具有不同表现特征的特征,表明V-JEPA 2.1确实对各种扭曲十分敏感.

blocks.en: Layer selection analysis. To further understand the representational capabilities of the encoder, we evaluate every single-layer and leave-one-out configuration of the hierarchical volume (Table 5 ). We first observe that hierarchical fusion offers an improvement ( + 0.012 +0.012 SROCC) over the standard method of extracting features only from the final layer. This improvement is achieved at negligible additional computational cost (only 11 additional GFLOPs), as all layers come from a single forward pass through the frozen encoder. Further analysis suggests that no individual layer is indispensable to our framework, while the four-layer combination yields the most robust results, indicating that different layers may capture complementary information that generalizes differently across data distributions. Overall, the hierarchical fusion yields modest but consistent improvements, although the gain is smaller than that obtained from the feature volume, as shown in Table 6 .
blocks.zh: 图层选择分析. 为了进一步理解编码器的代表性能力,我们评价等级卷的每个单层和一出一出配置(表5)。 我们首先观察到,分级聚变比标准方法(+ 0.012+ 0.012 SROCC)更能从最后层取出特征. 这种改进是以可忽略不计的额外计算成本(仅增加11个GFLOP)实现的,因为所有地层都来自从一个前行通过被冻结的编码器. 进一步的分析表明,我们的框架没有任何一个单独的层次是不可或缺的,而四层组合产生最强劲的结果,表明不同的层次可能捕捉到各种数据分布不同概括的互补信息。 如表6所示,总体来说,分级聚变产生适度而持续的改善,尽管增益小于从特性量得到的收益。

blocks.en: 4.6 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.6 阅读研究

blocks.en: Volumetric Embedding Network Ablation. We verify the effectiveness of the volumetric network by replacing it with a ridge regressor trained on the same multi-scale features and LSVQ training dataset (Table 6 ). The head improves average SROCC and PLCC by +0.040 and +0.036, respectively, confirming that a substantial gain in performance comes from the multi-scale volumetric network.

blocks.en: V-JEPA Backbone Ablation. In order to understand the low-level representational capacity of JEPA features, we replace the V-JEPA 2.1 trained ViT-B encoder with one image pre-trained ViT-B [ 44 ] and VideoMAE ViT-B [ 36 ] , which is another self-supervised video pre-training paradigm. Both of these encoders are ViT-B and have the same parameter count as the V-JEPA encoder. We train each replacement encoder under identical setups with the same HiVE-VQA framework. This ablation study shows that latent JEPA features greatly enhance performance with mean SROCC gains of +0.080 and +0.105, respectively. It is evident that features produced by JEPA pre-training hold powerful discriminative capacity for low-level representations.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we are, to the best of our knowledge, the first to employ a JEPA-based encoder for NR-VQA, demonstrating its enhanced capability to represent low-level quality information. We propose a lightweight quality module that effectively captures both local and global context from a hierarchical feature volume. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the HiVE-VQA model achieves strong generalizability and accurate quality prediction across both cross-dataset and task-specific evaluations, with predictions that correlate well with human subjective judgments. Future work will focus on reducing the total parameter count through techniques such as knowledge distillation [ 9 ] and model pruning [ 14 , 53 ] .
blocks.zh: 在本文件中,据我们所知,我们是第一个为NR-VQA使用基于JEPA的编码器的人,这显示了它更有能力代表低质量信息。 我们提出一个轻量级质量模块,从分级特征量中有效反映当地和全球情况。 广泛的实验表明,HIVE-VQA模型在跨数据集和任务特定评价中都实现了强烈的通俗性和准确的质量预测,而预测与人类主观判断密切相关. 今后的工作将侧重于通过知识分馏[9]和模型推算[14,53]等技术减少总参数数。
